PARAMS = {
    "gm1":  (1.2e-3, 0.95e-3, 1.45e-3),  # input-device gm target [S]
    "L1":   (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),             # input NMOS L
    "Lp":   (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),             # PMOS load L (sets gds2)
    "gmp":  (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),           # PMOS load gm/Id
    "Ib2":  (5e-6, 3e-6, 10e-6),         # PMOS-reference branch current
    "Ln":   (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),             # NMOS mirror L
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    vo = 0.9

    # Input device: Vgs is fixed by the input DC level, so size W to reach the gm target.
    L1 = p["L1"]
    r0 = lut.op("n", 10.0, L1, vin, vo)
    W1 = 10.0 * p["gm1"] / r0["gm"]
    W1 = min(max(W1, 0.42), 5000.0)
    r1 = lut.op("n", W1, L1, vin, vo)
    I1 = r1["Id"]
    gm1, gds1 = r1["gm"], r1["gds"]
    m1cap = lut.size("n", r1["gm_id"], L1, I1, vds=vo)   # used for parasitic estimates only

    # PMOS load carries exactly I1 at vout = 0.9 V.
    m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=vdd - vo)
    # PMOS reference diode: same gm/Id and L, sized at its own Vds = Vsg.
    mpr = lut.size("p", p["gmp"], p["Lp"], p["Ib2"], vds=m2.vgs)

    # NMOS mirror: ibias diode -> sink of Ib2 for the PMOS diode.
    mnr = lut.size("n", 10.0, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.65)
    mnr = lut.size("n", 10.0, p["Ln"], iref, vds=mnr.vgs)
    mn3 = lut.size("n", 10.0, p["Ln"], p["Ib2"], vds=vdd - mpr.vgs)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("M1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m2)
    n.dev("MPR", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpr)
    n.dev("MN3", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn3)
    n.dev("MNR", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnr)

    # First-order performance predictions
    gds_t = gds1 + m2.gds
    A = gm1 / gds_t
    Ctot = cl + m1cap.cdd + m2.cdd + m1cap.cgd
    f3db = gds_t / (2 * PI * Ctot)
    gbw = A * f3db
    power = vdd * (I1 + p["Ib2"] + iref)
    swing = (vdd - m2.vdsat - 0.05) - (0.25)
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A), "f3db": f3db, "gbw": gbw,
               "power": power, "vout_dc": vo, "swing": swing}
